visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal carousel of bordered teaser cards, several visible at once, mixed widths
traits: cards with image on top and text below inside a thin border
wide and compact cards side by side
scroll-snap track with next/previous arrows and dot indicators
external CTA links open in a new tab

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link. Optional cell 3: 'wide' for a wide card (default compact). Cells may be missing; a slide without an image renders text only. Optional label rows (2 cells, no image): Carousel label, Previous label, Next label, Slide label ('{n} of {total}'). UI strings have built-in English and German defaults chosen by the page language; any can be overridden with a row of the same name

usage: 'Current topics and news' sections and any multi-teaser row that overflows the page width.
reuseGuidance: Use when several teasers must be visible at once. For one full-width slide at a time use the vanilla carousel.
